QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_49

question.text: Swagruha's Niwas project repaired 1,265 families' homes in Dharavi Phase 2 at Rs. 4.67 Cr (Jan 2019-Dec 2022). The SIA's Investment Efficiency KPI is:

answer.text: Total project cost / Number of families benefited — expressing cost per family, here Rs. 4.67 Cr / 1,265 ≈ Rs. 36,917 per family

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the Chapter 8 Niwas KPI definition: Cost per family = Total project cost / Number of families benefited = Rs. 4,67,00,000 / 1,265 ≈ Rs. 36,917 per family. This is the Investment Efficiency indicator. The Trap: Options A, C, D are nonsensical combinations. Cross-Exam Context: Cost-per-beneficiary logic is also in X-A / X-B (Investment Adviser — fee-per-client) and XIX (AIF — cost-per-investor). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Benchmark Cost-per-Family against PMAY-G / PMAY-U published unit costs (~Rs. 1.2L - 2.5L). A gap of 10× below warrants investigation — either the SE did light-touch repair or data is wrong.
